voice.verified_from: creative_list_voices result 2026-11-27 + the V3 generation call (flow 6GOo3uZ0cfVXdKo1XftG) + the generation record of the 2026-11-27 trial take (voice name returned by creative_get_flow_run_status)

synthesis.language: en (prompt in English; language_code not set)

voice_settings.stability: not set -> connector default 0.5 (per creative_get_model_schema eleven_v4, read 2026-11-27)
voice_settings.similarity: not set -> connector default (the schema publishes no default value)
voice_settings.style_exaggeration: not exposed by this connector for eleven_v4
voice_settings.speed: not exposed / not set (natural speed of the performance)

synthesis.pronunciation_controls: none used (no dictionary, no IPA). If a name is misread, eleven_v4 accepts IPA between slashes in the prompt (/ʃɪˈvɔːn/).
synthesis.direction_method: inline audio tags in square brackets, one per phrase where the delivery changes (see performance.arc); punctuation for pauses (ellipses for suspense, commas for short beats), CAPS on one key word per line at most.
synthesis.never_regenerate: a take that is used in an edit is never regenerated; re-edits reuse the same take (owner rule 2026-11-16).

performance.formula: natural delivery + high energy + emotional variation + dynamic pacing + credible enthusiasm

arc.goal: confident, attention-grabbing first line, close to the action
slower for the basketball concept, emphasis on the key word
intensity rises right before the reveal
the peak; energetic but not shouting
energetic but controlled ending, a question or call to rewatch

avoid: pauses longer than ~0.6 s inside the take (timed silences are added in the edit only when honest, e.g. a decision window)
copying the V3 emphasis pattern mechanically: adapt the arc to each script

measured_reference.note: measured on the 2026-11-27 casting line (not listened to by Claude)

audio_processing.tone: highpass 85 Hz; -2 dB @ 300 Hz (Q 1.0); +3 dB @ 2.8 kHz (Q 1.4); -1.5 dB @ 7 kHz (Q 1.5); deesser i=0.45
audio_processing.compression: --preserve: threshold -18 dB, ratio 1.6:1, attack 8 ms, release 140 ms, makeup 2 dB
audio_processing.emotional_curve: per-line gain offsets (0 to +1 dB) changed only inside pauses; --preserve never turns a line down
audio_processing.mix: music ducked under the voice (sidechain); final -16 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -1 dBTP (alimiter -1.5 dBFS), 48 kHz
audio_processing.sfx: no ball-bounce / dribble sounds ever; no fake crowd; no gratuitous whooshes
